before_times: who it's for: your child (and their age), or you
for a child: are you the parent or legal guardian (often clear from 'my daughter')
what it's about, in a few words: speech and language, stuttering, voice, or feeding and swallowing (it sets the evaluation and its length; never the details)
languages spoken at home (a therapist who speaks it, or an interpreter)
a school plan (IEP) for speech: none, has one and wants private too, or wants the school's services
a doctor's referral: yes, or not yet
a health plan (its name only), Medicaid, or paying yourself
for a video session: which state the client will be in during the session
days and times that suit you, like after preschool
after_time: anything that helps at the visit, like a favorite toy or needing an interpreter
at home: who will be there, any pets, and where to park
at a preschool: the preschool's name and its contact for the visit day
secure_page_only: the child's name and birth date; the parent's name, how they're related, and 'I'm 18 or older'
plan member ID, the plan holder and photos of both sides of the plan card
the child's doctor, and the parent's OK for the office to ask for a referral
a copy of the school plan (IEP), if there is one
intake, consent and health history forms
who else may bring the child, with the parent's signed OK
for a preschool session: the parent's signed OK and the preschool's contact
intake_questions.never_asked: the child's name, birth date, the reason in detail, test results, the member ID and the health history never go through the AI chat: only the kind of visit, the child's age, the plan's name and the days and times
intake_questions.who_may_book: a parent or legal guardian for anyone under 18 (Rosie's rule for speech therapy, labeled as such, until a state's form says otherwise); an adult for themselves; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent, like after a stroke; anyone else, like a grandparent or a sitter, is asked to have a parent book
intake_questions.who_may_bring: a switch: the parent or guardian brings the child and stays, or an adult the parent names on the secure page with a signed OK; at a preschool or daycare session, the parent signs an OK and stays reachable by phone; a child is never with the therapist without the parent's OK

stop.words: sudden trouble speaking or understanding, a drooping face, or weakness on one side (stroke signs), at any age
choking now, trouble breathing, turning blue, or a child who can't swallow at all

stop.say: Call or text 988 now. If anyone is in danger right now, call 911.

go_on.words: coughing or gagging at meals, with no choking now
go_on.what: the safety words first (choking or trouble breathing: call 911), then the booking goes on: a feeding or swallowing evaluation, once the owner OKs it

go_on.words: a child who stopped using words they had
go_on.what: booked as an evaluation, and the parent is told to let the child's doctor know too; Rosie never judges how serious anything is

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988; every message is checked, every time

steps.name: The evaluation
steps.result: it sets the plan of care; sessions are booked after it, with the family's own yes

steps.name: The referral
steps.when: asked before the times (yes, or not yet)
steps.who: where the state's form, the plan or Medicaid asks for a doctor's referral or prescription before therapy (a switch)
steps.result: the evaluation goes ahead either way where the state allows; the office asks the child's doctor itself, with the parent's OK on the secure page; weekly sessions wait for it where it's needed

steps.name: Intake, consent and health history forms
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit; one reminder before it's due
steps.result: not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the desk or door first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand
steps.who: every family that names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the family may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay families
steps.when: told while booking; sent on time, as the federal rules say
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: The plan's OK for the sessions after the evaluation
steps.when: after the evaluation, asked by the desk on the plan's own website
steps.who: families whose plan asks for it
steps.result: OK'd: the weekly plan is booked within the sessions and dates OK'd; pending: only the next session is booked; no: self-pay, or stop

first_steps_and_forms.prep: come 10 minutes early to the first visit; bring a photo ID, the plan card, and any school plan or hearing test results; a parent stays for the whole visit

staff.skills: speech therapists: evaluations, re-checks, the plan of care, and every session; assistants: sessions only, under a speech therapist's plan of care, where the state allows; feeding and swallowing work only by a therapist trained for it (Iris, Caleb); each therapist's languages (Iris: Spanish); only people cleared for home visits go to homes and preschools; hearing tests only by an audiologist
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each speech therapist's own license, per state; an assistant's or a clinical fellow's credential where the state's form asks for one; an audiologist's own license for hearing tests
staff.supervision: an assistant or a clinical fellow works only under a named supervising speech therapist, with the supervision the state's form sets (a switch: on site, or reachable by phone); how many of a plan's sessions an assistant may do, and how often the therapist comes back, is a switch from the state's form too
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs same-day times, feeding or swallowing evaluations, any custom price (at the clinic, every one; at home, over $500), and anything a therapist flags
staff.stand_in: an evaluation or a re-check: only another speech therapist; a session: a speech therapist, or an assistant under the same plan; a video session: only someone licensed where the client is; the plug-in turns Rosie's no-reply default off: nobody, and never a child, is moved to another therapist without the family's yes

children_and_age.who_may_book: a parent or legal guardian for anyone under 18 (Rosie's rule for speech therapy, labeled as such, until a state's form says otherwise); an adult for themselves; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent, like after a stroke; anyone else, like a grandparent or a sitter, is asked to have a parent book
children_and_age.minors_texts: a child's texts go only to the parent or guardian's phone
children_and_age.minors_rules: who may consent for a minor, and at what age a minor may consent alone (a switch from the state form)

visit.check_in: at the clinic: the check-in code at the front desk, from the parent; by video: the code read out at the start, and the parent says which state the child is in that day; at home or at a preschool: the code at the door, from the parent or the adult named on the booking
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; results are explained in person; the written report and the plan of care stay in the practice's own records, never in Rosie or a text
visit.changes_at_visit: the evaluation sets the plan of care: goals, how many sessions a week, for how many weeks, and practice at home; any added service only with the parent's yes and its price first
visit.before_work: the therapist reads the intake forms, the school plan and any referral before starting

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: each speech-language pathologist (a speech therapist) holds their own active license from the state's board; a speech therapy assistant or a clinical fellow works only with the credential the state's form asks for, if any
license.who: each person; the practice too, where the state's form registers practices or their owners (a switch)
license.ask: each person's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the practice's registration number from the owner, where the state's form asks for one
license.insurance: malpractice insurance where the state's form asks for it

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the child's name, the visit type, the reason, the plan, test results or health details; at the clinic, no therapist's name in a family's texts; at home, the therapist's name stays, for the door check
languages: English and Spanish; a family's home language picks a therapist who speaks it, or an interpreter the practice sets up
